label: Are you willing to do the hand grip test? - Myofit sub-study
meta_rows: Are you willing to do the hand grip test? - Myofit sub-study

Grip Strength done in the Myofit sub-study. For those participants who were unable to do the test during the 2023 Home visit, they were asked to do the test during the Myofit clinic visit. These need to be merged with the 2023 HV and NOT the 2015 HV.
linked_rows: Are you willing to do the hand grip test? - at age 77 years
cat_rows: Study participants were asked by the attending nurse whether they would be willing to have their grip strength assessed.  If willing and able (reasons for inability included health reasons and broken dynamometers) up to 6 tests of grip strength were performed, 3 in the dominant hand and 3 in the non-dominant hand, using a Nottingham electronic dynamometer. Participants who were unable to do the test during the 2023 Home visit were asked to when they took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
